question: What is the rank of India in the production of rice globally? (As of year 2020)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of the year **2020**, **India ranks second** in the** production of rice** globally **after China**.
 
• In the eastern and southern parts of India, **rice **is a staple grain that **needs** temperatures of about **25 degrees Celsius** and more than **100 centimeters of precipitation**.
 
• **Rice production in India** has increased from** 53.6 million tons** in **1980 **to **120 million tons** in **2020–21**.
 
• A few Indian states have better production rates since they have enough soil and water available. The **top four Indian states** that produce the most rice are **West Bengal**, **Uttar Pradesh**, Andhra Pradesh, and Punjab.
 
• The **world's largest exporter of basmati rice** is **India**. The states that grow the most Basmati rice include Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Jammu & Kashmir, Haryana, Delhi, Uttarakhand, and Western Uttar Pradesh.
